message.content:
London’s official time‑zone identifier is **Europe/London**.  
- During standard time (roughly late October – late March) it follows **Greenwich Mean Time (GMT)**, which is **UTC + 0**.  
- During daylight‑saving time (late March – late October) it switches to **British Summer Time (BST)**, which is **UTC + 1**.  

So depending on the season you’ll see either GMT (UTC + 0) or BST (UTC + 1).
